note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a IND 8, 9, 14; A06b IND 8, 9, 14; L05 IND 23(a)): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Wedlock restriction), A01b (descent, born abroad: Wedlock restriction), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from either parent, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states. The coding also records a wedlock restriction (a child born out of wedlock may not take it from a citizen father), which the form doesn't hold. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Indonesia, 2024
sources.said: Person has been continuously resident in Indonesia for 5 years or intermittently for 10 years. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required. ... Person voluntarily acquires a foreign citizenship. ... Wedlock restriction ... Person is born in wedlock to a citizen or out of wedlock to a mother who is a citizen. ... Wedlock restriction ... Person is born in wedlock to a citizen or out of wedlock to a mother who is a citizen. If the person also acquired another citizenship, s/he needs to choose between the different citizenships upon reaching the age of 18 or upon marriage. ... No provision ... No provision

atBirth.descentAbroad: Person is born in wedlock to a citizen or out of wedlock to a mother who is a citizen. If the person also acquired another citizenship, s/he needs to choose between the different citizenships upon reaching the age of 18 or upon marriage.
